summary: S1 explicitly reports random assignment of intact classes to ChatGLM with minimal teacher intervention, ChatGLM with teacher structure support, or traditional instruction with web search. The coded assignment, generative-AI assistance, and comparison arms are supported, so criterion 1 holds despite the authors’ quasi-experimental label.
